End-to-end encryption means nobody else\:
Kutsekedwa kwa uthenga kuyambira kumapeto mpaka kumapeto kumatanthauza kuti palibe wina amene
                angathe — sizingatheke kukhala kuti mthandizi ayankha chinthu chomwe sanachiona. Mode ya anonimous
                imayankha funso lachitsanzo la ngati ayenera kudziwa amene adapereza funsolo.

Chidzipatso cha mathero (End-to-end encryption) zikutanthauza kuti palibe wina amene angathe. Sizikutanthauza kapena kutha kutanthauza kuti mthandizi mayankha chinthu chimene sawonapo — kukhala wobisa dzina ndi yankho la funso lina lachilendo la ngati ayenera kudziwa yemwe afunsa.

Standing facts Nymbot carries between ch: Zinthu zoona zomwe Nymbot amanyamula pakati pa zokambirana, zikusungidwa imodzi ndi imodzi kuti iliyonse inga iphunziridwe, kukonzedwa, kapena kutailidwa payekha. Zimenezo zimakhala pa chida chino; zochepa zomwe zikukhudza funso limodzi zimayenda m'menemo m'menemo m'uthenga umenewo, zakunyalidwa monga zinthu zina zonse zomwe mumatumiza. Zokambirana zachinsinsi sizimawerenga kapena kuwonjezera kanthu pa izo.

Zochitika zozama zimene Nymbot amayendetsa pakati pa macheza, zikusungidwa imodzi pa nthawi kuti iliyonse ingathe kuwerengedwa, kukonzedwa kapena kutayidwa payokha. Zimakhala pa chida chino; zochepa zomwe zili ndi yankho la funso limayenda m'menemo mwa uthenga umenewo, zolengedwa mwachinsinsi monga zonse zina zomwe mumatumiza. Munthu amene akuchita macheza achinsinsi samaziwerenga kapena kuonjezera zambiri mwa iwo.

Zinthu zoona zomwe Nymbot amanyamula pakati pa macheza: zomwe tiyeletere dzina lanu, zomwe mumagwira ntchito, komanso mmene mumafunira kuti mayankho alembedwe. Zilemba imodzi imasungidwa nthawi imodzi kuti muthe kuwerenga mndandandawu, kukonza ndime yomwe ndi yolakwika, komanso kutaya imene simunali kufuna kusunga — chidule chomwe chikupitilira chimatha kusungidwa mosavuta. Zinthu zoona zomwe mumatchula mwachidule zimalingaliridwa ndipo nthawi zonse zimatchulidwa mokweza, ndi kukanikiza kamodzi kuti muzichotsenzerapo; ngati mwatseka malingaliro amenewa ndipo ?remember amakhalabe kugwira ntchito. With \"Each task gets its own branch\" o: Tikakhazikitsa "Each task gets its own branch", ntchito ya repository imasunga (commit) mu branch yatsopano yomwe ili ndi dzina la nymbot/ komanso iditi yaing'ono, yomwe imapangidwa kuchokera ku working branch pamene ikupanga commit yoyamba, choncho ntchito zingapo pa repository imodzi zimayenda limodzi ndipo palibe chomwe chimakwera ku working branch popanda inu. Ikamaliza imatsegula pull request, ikupereka mwayi woti iphatikizidwe (merge) kapena kusiya branch, monga momwe mumasankhira pa Settings pansi pa When done kapena pa repository iliyonse. Mayankho amaonetsa branch ndi Open PR, Merge ndi Delete. Merge ndi merge commit, ndipo palibe chomwe chimaperekedwa mwa njira ya force-push. Ngati pali kusagwirizana (conflict), tsegulani pull request kuti muthetse vutolo kapena pemphani Nymbot kuti ikonze branch. Kusintha kwa ma CI ndi workflow files sikusintha, kumakhala kuyembekezera ku unobedwe wanu. Clean up Nymbot branches imafuta ma branch omwe akaunti iyi inasunga ndipo pull request yake yatha kapena tatseka, kapena amene akhala sabwerera kwa sabiti imodzi ndipo alibe chomwe chofuna kuphatikiza, koma sikufuta limodzi amene asinthidwa. Zimozani chitikiti chotere kuti ntchito isunge (commit) mwachindunji ku working branch, ntchito imodzi pa nthawi imodzi.
